_doc: Flourish connectors: optional, chosen for looks when they fit the beat window. `from`/`to` match a move name, a state name (REST/MID/SALUTE/LOW_TIP), a family tag (high/low_left/low_right/guard/bar), or '*'. `via` lists named states and/or explicit poses [pan, lift, elbow, wrist, roll, jaw] (sim degrees) the arm passes through in order. `weight` ranks flourishes when several fit; `min_window` seconds needed.

twirl_up.note: sword vertical, wrist twirls back and forth, then re-cock

salute_reset.note: come up through the salute before a high move

tip_tap.note: tap the blade tip on the board between guards (jaw flick)

low_crouch.note: dip through the low tip pose when switching slash sides

hub_pause.note: plain route through the hub (the default fallback)
